WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    e.ID,
    AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg,
    AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ana
  FROM Examination e
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY e.ID
),
sex_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    AVG(pa.avg_acl_igg) as avg_acl_igg_by_sex,
    AVG(pa.avg_ana) as avg_ana_by_sex
  FROM patient_avgs pa
  JOIN Patient p ON pa.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
overall_mean_ana AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ana_by_sex) as overall_mean_ana
  FROM sex_avgs
)
SELECT 
  s.SEX,
  s.avg_acl_igg_by_sex,
  s.avg_ana_by_sex,
  s.avg_ana_by_sex / om.overall_mean_ana as ana_ratio
FROM sex_avgs s
CROSS JOIN overall_mean_ana om
ORDER BY s.SEX
